notes.subject: יקפאון
notes.rationale: Unique form of קפא 'to congeal/freeze'; only occurrence in Tanakh.

notes.subject: יקרות יקפאון
notes.rationale: KJV 'not clear nor dark'; ASV 'the bright ones shall withdraw'; JPS 'heavy clouds and thick' — the two words are famously opaque.

notes.subject: lait i tanimap
notes.rationale: Cosmic sign deliberately obscure: light neither clear nor gone, withheld from explanation.

translation: Na long dispela de bai i no gat lait i klia — lait bilong gutpela kain bai i tanimap, i solap olsem ais.

tokens.gloss: bai i tanimap, i solap olsem ais
